strengths.I003: A small, scoring-only change (about 60 lines, one flag) that targets a real weakness of top-3-by-mean selection, correlated same-lever duplicates, and can be tested offline on saved records with best-of-3 as the primary outcome and a paired bootstrap over briefs.
strengths.I007: Regresses out nuisance covariates (length, hedges, family match) and reduces to the current ranking when labels are scarce, so it addresses judge bias directly and could learn systematic selection error from the library.

verdicts.reason: I003 is a clean on/off scoring switch with a named primary metric (best-of-3) testable on existing data at almost no cost, whereas I007 needs at least 15 labelled briefs, is fragile to Goodhart effects when labels come from the panel, and will be swamped by brief heterogeneity at about 10 labels per brief.

strengths.I006: A named development-stage mechanism (a bounded repair loop driven by executed FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE checks, with an adjudicator from a third model family) that can improve the claims in the delivered ideas, isolable via develop.mode and templates.enabled, and measurable through the falsified-claim rate under a held-out checker rather than rater opinion. The cross-run template library is something a lone agent lacks.
strengths.I008: Cheap to build (about 3 days, no extra tokens at equal budget), explicitly models and corrects position and self-preference bias, and can be tested offline by Kendall tau against external strengths.

verdicts.reason: I006 improves the content of the ideas through development, with an outcome measured by a held-out checker and a cross-run compounding effect a single agent cannot match, while I008 only reweights the selection votes, which likely gives a small gain when the judges are similar and depends on about 300 externally rated past votes.
